title: Produce select component audit sheet
description: Audit the select filter as an individual native dropdown component with explicit browser limits, placeholder/all option, and safe styling contracts.
objective: Define what select can safely customize in Elementor without pretending native dropdowns are fully controllable.
acceptance_criteria: Label, native select, placeholder/all option, option data, focus, disabled, hover, browser styling limits, and responsive behavior are treated as separate subelements.
Native browser limitations are documented instead of ignored.
Safe controls are separated from enhanced-select ideas.
The audit does not implement select fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: select render, option parser, field CSS, frontend JS
budgets.research_budget: local source plus native-control notes if needed

risks: Native select can become inconsistent across browsers if overstyled.
Enhanced-select ideas can expand scope before the base control is stable.
